svg.title: UML Class / Domain Model - JobPortal BD

g.text: UML Class / Domain Model - JobPortal BD
Modeling choice: the backend is functional JavaScript (CommonJS modules + Mongoose schemas),
not an OO class hierarchy. Entities below are the Mongoose models (persistent domain).
Controllers, middleware and utilities are in class-diagram-modules.puml.
Associations are ObjectId references resolved in application code (populate);
MongoDB does not enforce them. User has no subclasses: "role" is an enum field.
«pre save» hash password if modified (bcrypt, 10 rounds)
